successors.name: Karangasem-Lombok
successors.text: the kingdom's centre at Selaparang, present-day Selaparang village, Suwela district, East Lombok

ledger.x: c. 1500 (bridged): the page gives no founding year; Sayyid Zulqarnain founded it as descendant line of Kerajaan Kayangan. Start year taken from the task hint.
c. 1672: 'an expedition from Karangasem (Bali), joined by Arya Banjar Getas, conquered Selaparang'.
c. 1672: Selaparang falls; Karangasem rules west Lombok, Arya Banjar Getas parts of east and centre.

certainty.note: No start year and no boundaries on the page.
